paper_record.title: Andreev Reflection to Probe Momentum-Dependent Spin Polarization in Altermagnet CrSb
paper_record.abstract: Altermagnetic materials have recently emerged as promising candidates for next-generation spintronic applications, characterized by the k-dependent spin-splitted band structure and a simultaneous zero-net-magnetization. Among them, altermagnetic candidate CrSb has attracted considerable attention, owing to its g-wave spin splitting and high Néel temperature. In this article, we employed mechanical point-contact spectroscopy (MPCS) with superconducting Nb tips to probe the Andreev reflection on CrSb single crystals along three principal crystallographic orientations. The extracted momentum-dependent spin polarizations are approximately 73.4% for the (0001) plane, 67.9% for the (-1-120) plane, and 61.9% for the (10-10) plane, respectively, distinct from conventional antiferromagnets. Furthermore, conductance spectra from spatial line-scans on the sample surface support the existence of altermagnetic domains with a characteristic size of 250-500 nm separated by domain-walls with width about 250 nm. These results strongly support the momentum-dependent spin polarization in altermagnetic CrSb and establish Andreev reflection as a new paradigm to probe k-dependent spin textures.

one_sentence_summary.zh: 通过机械点接触谱（MPCS）实验，证实了反铁磁材料 CrSb 中存在动量依赖的自旋极化及畴结构。
one_sentence_summary.en: Experimental confirmation of momentum-dependent spin polarization and domain structures in the altermagnetic candidate CrSb using mechanical point-contact spectroscopy (MPCS).

problem.zh: 如何有效探测反铁磁材料（特别是交错磁体）中动量依赖的自旋极化，并克服传统 ARPES 测量中因大光斑导致的畴平均效应。
problem.en: How to effectively probe momentum-dependent spin polarization in altermagnets while overcoming domain-averaging effects inherent in large-spot ARPES measurements.

approach.zh: 利用超导 Nb 尖端对 CrSb 单晶进行机械点接触谱（MPCS）测量，结合修正的 BTK 模型提取自旋极化率，并通过空间扫描探测畴结构。
approach.en: Employing mechanical point-contact spectroscopy (MPCS) with superconducting Nb tips on CrSb single crystals, using a modified BTK model to extract spin polarization, and performing spatial line-scans to map domain structures.

main_takeaway.zh: CrSb 表现出显著的动量依赖自旋极化（约 62%-73%），且 MPCS 能够有效区分不同畴区，证实了其作为交错磁体的特性。
main_takeaway.en: CrSb exhibits significant momentum-dependent spin polarization (approx. 62%-73%), and MPCS effectively resolves local domain structures, confirming its altermagnetic nature.

why_it_matters.zh: 该研究确立了 Andreev 反射作为探测交错磁体动量依赖自旋织构的新范式，为自旋电子学应用提供了实验依据。
why_it_matters.en: This work establishes Andreev reflection as a new paradigm for probing momentum-dependent spin textures in altermagnets, providing experimental support for future spintronic applications.

reason.zh: 首次通过点接触谱实验定量测量了 CrSb 的动量依赖自旋极化，并成功解析了其微观畴结构。
reason.en: First quantitative experimental measurement of momentum-dependent spin polarization in CrSb via point-contact spectroscopy, successfully resolving its microscopic domain structure.

reason.zh: 该研究涉及当前凝聚态物理的热点领域（交错磁体），且采用了高精度的实验手段，符合 PRL 的发表风格。
reason.en: The research addresses a hot topic in condensed matter physics (altermagnetism) and employs high-precision experimental techniques, fitting the profile of PRL.
